summary: Back 4 Blood entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Back 4 Blood
entries.definitive_edition: Windows version with Annual Pass / Ultimate Edition content installed

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; no emulator required.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC native resolution/settings with Annual Pass content

primary.version: Windows version with Annual Pass / Ultimate Edition content installed
primary.why: Windows, Windows Apps, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series releases exist. The Annual Pass contains the three story/content drops, so the Windows route with that content installed is the highest-fidelity complete archive path; no platform-exclusive campaign content exists elsewhere.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows/Steam build or equivalent PC ownership path with the Annual Pass/Ultimate content installed. Patch fully, confirm online/login requirements before capture, and record at native PC settings.

entries.remaster_caveats: Not a remaster. The important caveat is live-service/account state and Annual Pass ownership; the base game alone is not the complete content route.
